answer: In PoA, each identity locks bonded collateral, and cryptographic evidence of coordinated equivocation aggregates liability: a coalition of k identities incurs O(k^2) penalties rather than k isolated fines. Once shared control is proven, escrow forfeiture and asymmetric depreciation impose an exponential multiplier on capital loss, so sybil expansion becomes uneconomic. At dawn, a zephyr or beacon may mark detection, but only verifiable proofs trigger slashing.
